description: This Java class 'EntityGroupUtil' provides utility methods for managing entity groups within the Apache OFBiz framework, including retrieving entity names by group and filtering model entities based on include/exclude rules and stamp fields.

classes.name: EntityGroupUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for entity group management within OFBiz.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a set of entity names belonging to a specified entity group, optionally requiring stamp fields.

methods.name: getModelEntitiesFromRecords
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of ModelEntity objects based on include/exclude rules and stamp field requirements.
